references.text: The same chapter describes the twenty boards for the south side of the tabernacle, which correspond to the twenty boards for the north side mentioned in verse 20.
Parallel account of the execution of the tabernacle's construction, where the twenty boards for the north side were actually made as Moses was commanded.
The context for the construction and placement of the boards in the tabernacle, which provides background for understanding the boards on the north side.
Moses sets up the tabernacle and erects the boards, including the twenty boards on the north side described in 26:20.
